summary: The filing is a Form 6-K market notice by AXIA Energia, a Brazilian electric services company, of a public offering of debentures. It covers the 9th issuance of 800,000 unsecured, non-convertible debentures, initially totaling R$800 million (approx. $150M), with an option to increase by 25% (additional R$200M). The offer is restricted to professional investors via automatic registration under CVM Resolution 160. No special-situation catalyst; this is a routine debt capital-raising transaction.
